title: Agent0 Feature Tree
description: Machine-readable projection of the project's feature graph. Generated by /feature-tree alongside FEATURE_TREE.md. The single source of truth that canvas.html (the feature canvas) renders. Humans never hand-edit this file — edit the source Markdown and re-run /feature-tree.

version.description: Schema version of this document. Currently "1".

generated.description: Timestamp the file was generated, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.

rooms.description: The top-level groupings (domains / page-groups / services). A room is the 'parent' of one or more feature nodes. Auto-derived from the distinct `room` values across nodes, then enriched from .github/specs/_rooms.yml when present.

nodes.description: Every feature / endpoint / component / schema / integration in the project.

edges.description: Dependency edges between nodes. Derived from each node's `dependsOn`. Redundant with dependsOn but convenient for graph renderers.

bugs.description: Open/in-progress bugs, optionally pinned to a node via `node`. Mirrors the Bugs section of FEATURE_TREE.md.

stats.description: Aggregate counts for the canvas header.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id, referenced by node.room.

title.description: Display name. Defaults to titleized id.

icon.description: Tabler outline icon name, e.g. ti-shopping-cart. Optional.

summary.description: One-line description of the room. Optional.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id. Defaults to the spec directory name. The ONE field that must stay stable over a node's lifetime — edges reference it.

kind.description: What this node represents, which determines its LAYER: page/component = frontend; endpoint/service = backend; schema = data; integration = external; feature = a vertical slice spanning layers (the default). The room is the domain; the kind is the layer. Drives layer coloring + the kind filter on the canvas.

summary.description: AI short version — one line. Derived from requirements.md first paragraph, or the `summary` frontmatter override.

detail.description: AI full version — a paragraph. Derived from design.md ## Approach, else the verification.md intro. Not a spec file; a rollup.

status.description: Lifecycle state. See feature-tree.prompt.md > 'Node status' for the derivation precedence.

verification.description: Verification state, or null if no verification.md exists yet.

todo.description: The ongoing board, derived from tasks.md checkbox state: [x]=done, [~]=doing, [ ]=next.

surfaces.description: User/machine entry points, from verification.md ## Surfaces. e.g. '/login — page'.

invariants.description: Load-bearing invariants/constraints for this feature — the rules that must not break. From requirements.md ## Constraints (and any hard rules in design.md). Shown in the canvas detail panel.

flair.description: Flair — choices Claude made that were never specified (styling calls, defaults, copy, structure), plus any other spec detail that isn't a hard rule. Freely changeable, in contrast to invariants. From design.md ## Flair. Edited in-app via the Scaffold overlay (scaffold.js).

dependsOn.description: Ids of nodes this node depends on. The edge layer of the graph.

artifacts.description: Pointers to the source Markdown this node was rolled up from. Absolute paths so Claude Code / the canvas can open them.

files.description: Present spec files, by role. Missing files are omitted.

passing.description: Count of checkpoints whose Last result is pass.

state.description: Normalized from verification.md Last result. 'pending: needs X' collapses to pending.

pendingReason.description: The 'needs X' detail when state is pending.

node.description: Node id this bug is pinned to, if any.
